rules.statement: Redo transport degradation to the standby caused a growing apply/transport lag
causal_chain: redo transport to the standby slows or fails

supporting_conditions.description: transport lag above the accepted threshold
redo transport errors observed on the network path

contradicting_conditions.description: lag well below the threshold contradicts degradation

manual_actions.action_summary: Review the redo transport configuration with the network team and adjust it after approval
manual_actions.precheck: Confirm current transport status and lag on each affected standby
manual_actions.risk: A transport change can interrupt redo shipping for the affected standby
manual_actions.postcheck: Confirm transport is healthy and lag returns below the accepted threshold

rules.statement: Disk group free space exhaustion prevented file allocation
causal_chain: disk group free space reaches the floor

supporting_conditions.description: disk group free space at or below the floor
path errors observed for the disk group members

manual_actions.action_summary: Add capacity to the affected disk group after storage team review
manual_actions.precheck: Confirm free space, redundancy and rebalance state for the disk group
manual_actions.risk: Capacity operations trigger rebalance activity that affects I/O
manual_actions.postcheck: Confirm free space and that rebalance completed without errors

rules.statement: Open plug-in violations left the PDB in restricted mode

contradicting_conditions.description: PDB not restricted contradicts the cause

manual_actions.action_summary: Resolve the open plug-in violations for the affected PDB after review
manual_actions.precheck: List the recorded violations and their impact for the PDB
manual_actions.risk: Resolving a violation can change PDB configuration and require a reopen
manual_actions.postcheck: Confirm the PDB opens read write without restricted mode

rules.statement: Fast recovery area exhaustion blocked archived log deletion and backups

supporting_conditions.description: FRA usage at or above the limit
archived log deletion blocked by retention

manual_actions.action_summary: Review the FRA size and retention policy with the backup owner and adjust it after approval
manual_actions.precheck: Confirm FRA usage, retention policy and backup status
manual_actions.risk: Retention changes affect recoverability and must be reviewed
manual_actions.postcheck: Confirm FRA usage decreases and the next backup completes

rules.statement: A locked service account caused authentication failures
causal_chain: failed login attempts lock the service account

contradicting_conditions.description: account not locked contradicts the cause

manual_actions.action_summary: Unlock the affected service account after confirming the origin of the failed logins with the security team
manual_actions.precheck: Confirm account status and the source of the failed login attempts
manual_actions.risk: Unlocking without finding the source can repeat the lock or hide an attack
manual_actions.postcheck: Confirm the application authenticates and no new lock occurs
